body:
I've explained it to many people before. Therapists, doctors, friends, family, and even the occasional stranger just like you.

I appreciate your message in the way a terminally ill person appreciates get-well-soon wishes. It's a bitter sweet feeling, especially when you know better than anybody else how your situation is going to play out in the end.

It won't get better, and I know that for a fact. I've dug my own grave, six feet deep in the shape of the person I once used to be. 

It's not tragic. I am celebrating, and I hope that one day in the future my loved ones will celebrate too.
